title: Parliament opens debate on key national reforms
author: Alfred G. Ondieki
summary: Members of Parliament began debating governance and public finance reforms expected to shape Kenya's policy agenda.
body:
NAIROBI — Parliament today opened debate on a series of national reform proposals touching on governance, accountability and public finance.

Legislators spent the first sitting examining measures aimed at improving transparency in the management of public resources and strengthening service delivery across government institutions.

Several parliamentary committees are expected to present amendments before the proposed legislation proceeds to the next stage of debate.

title: Nairobi markets react to latest economic announcements
author: Alfred G. Ondieki
summary: Businesses and investors continue monitoring policy developments that could influence Kenya's economic outlook.
body:
NAIROBI — Kenya's financial markets reacted cautiously as businesses assessed the latest economic policy announcements.

Economists say investor confidence, inflation and the cost of doing business remain among the most closely watched indicators in the country's economic recovery.

Industry leaders have called for predictable policies that encourage investment while protecting households from rising living costs.

title: Kenyan athletes intensify preparations for global competitions
author: Alfred G. Ondieki
summary: Athletics and football remain at the centre of Kenya's sporting calendar as teams prepare for major international events.
body:
NAIROBI — Kenyan athletes have entered the final phase of preparations ahead of several international competitions.

Training camps are focusing on endurance, tactical discipline and injury prevention as athletes aim to maintain Kenya's strong reputation on the global stage.

Sports officials remain optimistic that the country's representatives will deliver competitive performances in the coming events.

title: County governments unveil new community development projects
author: Alfred G. Ondieki
summary: County administrations have announced new infrastructure, healthcare and youth empowerment initiatives.
body:
NAIROBI — Several county governments have launched community development projects aimed at improving public services and creating employment opportunities.

The initiatives include road rehabilitation, healthcare expansion, water access and youth empowerment programmes designed to strengthen local economies.

Implementation timelines differ across counties, with most projects expected to begin during the current financial year.

title: Universities expand digital learning opportunities for students
author: Alfred G. Ondieki
summary: Higher learning institutions are investing in digital education to improve access and flexibility for learners.
body:
NAIROBI — Universities across Kenya are expanding online learning platforms and digital academic resources to improve access to higher education.

Education stakeholders say technology is becoming increasingly important in delivering lectures, assessments and collaborative learning opportunities.

The move is expected to benefit students in remote areas while supporting more flexible learning models.

title: Heavy rainfall alert issued for parts of western Kenya
author: Worldiex Weather Desk
summary: Residents in several western counties have been advised to prepare for periods of heavy rainfall and possible flooding.
body:
NAIROBI — Weather forecasters have advised residents in parts of western Kenya to remain alert following forecasts of sustained heavy rainfall.

Authorities are urging communities living near rivers and flood-prone areas to monitor official updates and avoid attempting to cross flooded roads.

Emergency response agencies say they remain on standby should weather conditions worsen.
